title: IssuingNetworkToken
description: An issuing token object is created when an issued card is added to a digital wallet. As a [card issuer](https://docs.stripe.com/issuing), you can [view and manage these tokens](https://docs.stripe.com/issuing/controls/token-management) through Stripe.

created.description: Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.

device_fingerprint.description: The hashed ID derived from the device ID from the card network associated with the token.

last4.description: The last four digits of the token.

livemode.description: If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.

network.description: The token service provider / card network associated with the token.

network_updated_at.description: Time at which the token was last updated by the card network. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.

object.description: String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.

status.description: The usage state of the token.

wallet_provider.description: The digital wallet for this token, if one was used.
